To request an accommodation, email recruitment@actblue.com. *ActBlue will _never_ ask candidates to buy equipment, nor will we email from anything other than an actblue.com or actbluetech.com email address.

content.title: Quality Assurance & Advocacy Lead Analyst at Airspace
content.description: Company Introduction: Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors. Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m. The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics. Job Overview The Quality Assurance & Advocacy Lead Analyst investigates customer escalations, analyzes operational data to spot trends, and drives corrective and preventive action across Operations to protect the reliability Airspace’s clients depend on for their most time-critical shipments. This role is a fit for someone who’s analytical and detail-driven, comfortable turning data into root-cause findings and clear documentation, and confident delivering feedback and performance reviews to Operations Leadership and Account Managers — someone who wants to build a quality-first culture, not just enforce one. What You’ll Do Including but not limited to: Support CAPA/shipment investigations — root cause analysis and corrective action implementation, and help review and report on trends. Investigate and resolve complex escalations; identify customer trends, quality concerns, and operational gaps to drive continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Provide recommendations to continuously improve procedures and policies throughout the organization. Analyze calls and provide feedback to ensure Operations Specialists are delivering the best communication to Airspace clients. Research customer satisfaction issues, develop corrective action plans, and monitor results through to closure. Onboard new hires into ZenQMS under the QMS function, including setting up their reporting lines, and assist the QMS Manager with other tasks as needed. Assist with customer error codes. Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Director of QA&A, Sr. Manager of QMS, and/or Chief Business Officer. Maintain expertise across all Airspace Sectors and Subsectors: Industrials Aerospace & Defense High Tech Manufacturing & Industrials 3PL & Other Healthcare Lifesciences Health Systems & Labs Medical Devices Requirements Minimum of 5 years’ experience in a QA&A Analyst, Customer Advocate, Lead, or Sr. QA&A department position, or any of the following: 5+ years of experience in Airspace Operations, with at least 2 years’ experience in an Operations Management role. 7+ years’ experience in the Industry with a competitor, with at least 4 years’ experience in an Operations Management, Quality Assurance role, or Customer Advocate position. Technical skills/knowledge: Mastery of 5-Why Principles and Analysis, most critically identifying root causes and the development and implementation of solutions (corrective actions & preventative actions). ZenQMS for documenting audits, findings, and corrective/preventive action plans. Zendesk for ticket management and escalations, especially for analysts with a Primary Sector assignment. WorkRamp for completing the required Guide/Pathway training for Quality Assurance Management & Advocacy. Working knowledge of the live order/shipment tracking system needed to conduct real-time order analysis. Familiarity with the call monitoring/recording system used to review Operations Specialist client communication. Non-technical skills/qualities: Delivers clear feedback via ZenQMS on call quality (Twilio calls), customer complaints, coaching Juggles live order monitoring, call reviews, open investigations, and cross-sector requests without letting slower-burning work (like corrective action follow-through) fall through the cracks. Spots when a customer satisfaction issue points to a broader process gap and recommends policy or procedure changes company-wide. Understands Airspace’s products, services, mission, and strategic goals well enough to judge whether a recommendation actually serves the business, not just the individual ticket. Drives corrective actions across Operations and other teams QA&A doesn’t directly manage. Comfortable being assigned to a Primary Sector while remaining flexible to jump into any sector as operational needs shift, including extended hours, evenings, and weekends. Role Details Department: Quality Assurance & Advocacy (QA&A) Reports to: Director of QA&A Location: Remote Schedule: Monday-Friday, with flexibility for weekends if required due to business needs Success Metrics This year: Salesforce, Zendesk, and Slack access provisioned and used independently (no walkthroughs needed) by day 30 100% of required ZenQMS and WorkRamp training modules completed by day 30, with passing scores on any built-in assessments Can independently pull a record/case in Salesforce and Zendesk without assistance by end of month 1 Manager sign-off that the person can take on a full independent caseload of lower/moderate escalations without required review Has met 1:1 or in small group with key stakeholders across Operations, Quality, and relevant account teams by day 30-45 Has observed the full error code process for specific customer accounts by day 30 Next year: Recognized as the go-to escalation owner for the most complex or highest-risk accounts CAPA and root-cause work shows measurable downstream impact — fewer repeat escalations, reduced cycle time to resolution Trend analysis becomes proactive rather than reactive: issues are flagged and addressed before they become customer-facing escalations Consistently and independently investigates and resolves complex customer escalations with minimal need for manager intervention Leads CAPA investigations end-to-end — identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions Builds strong working relationships across Ops Leadership, Account Management, Operations, and Quality — seen as a reliable cross-functional partner. Identifies at least one or two recurring customer/quality trends and drives a continuous improvement initiative in response Your First 90 Days Successfully complete onboarding by gaining proficiency in core operational platforms (Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack) and completing all required training modules in ZenQMS and WorkRamp. Shadow escalation handling and CAPA investigations to learn Airspace QA&A documentation standards Learn the escalation workflow across Operations, Quality — know who to go to for what Observe specific customer error code process, compile data, and present key findings to leadership. Begin independently handling lower-to-moderate complexity escalations with manager review Sit in on customer meetings/CAPA discussions (Teams/Zoom) to understand tone, structure, and expectations Build initial relationships with key cross-functional stakeholders Your First 180 Days Complete CAPA investigations from root-cause analysis through corrective action implementation Develop expertise in specific customer error codes, analyzing system data to help leadership identify failure trends and drive continuous process improvements. Identify a customer or quality trend from the data and propose a continuous improvement or risk mitigation action Investigate and resolve complex escalations; identify customer trends, quality concerns, and operational gaps to drive continuous improvement and risk mitigation. Be seen as a trusted, self-sufficient point of contact by internal teams Compensation & Benefits Salary range: $75,000.00 to $80,000.00 annually High-quality health, dental, and vision plan options Open PTO 401K with company match Professional learning and training reimbursements Core Values: We are One Team . We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together. We make an Impact . We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world. We are Passionate . We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar. We are Transparent . We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers. We are Innovative . We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves. Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations. A friendly reminder: Airspace will only contact candidates from an @airspace.com email, a no-reply notification from no-reply@us.greenhouse-mail.io , or a verified LinkedIn profile. We never request fees or sensitive personal/financial information during recruiting. If something seems suspicious or feels off, please reach out to us at recruiting@airspace.com before responding. For this role the acquisition of recruitment agencies is not appreciated, thank you for your understanding.

content.title: Enterprise Account Executive, West at Vanta
content.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As an Enterprise Account Executive at Vanta, you will play a critical role in expanding our footprint in the Enterprise segment through net-new logo acquisition. This is a high-impact role focused on a land and expand model, requiring a results-driven seller capable of closing 5+ six-figure opportunities per quarter. You’ll be joining a team that is building and scaling our upmarket motion, and you’ll help shape Vanta’s strategy and execution in some of our most strategic segments. This role requires someone who is equally confident navigating complex deals independently and working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and the channel. Success in this role means driving full-cycle deals from prospecting through close - both directly and through partners. At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. The ideal candidate for this role at Vanta has prior security or adjacent domain experience. We’re growing quickly, continually outpacing our targets and leading the market in compliance and security. If you’re excited by the opportunity to drive strategic, high-value deals and work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment—we’d love to hear from you. What you’ll do as an Enterprise Account Executive at Vanta: Own and drive net-new business acquisition within the Enterprise segment Close 5+ six-figure opportunities per quarter, managing the full sales cycle from initial outreach through contract execution Build and maintain a strong pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound leads, referrals, SDR partnership and partner/channel collaboration Engage directly with senior stakeholders (CISO, CIO, CTO) to deliver tailored, consultative value propositions Work closely with legal, product, engineering, solution engineers, and GRC specialists throughout the deal cycle Leverage and contribute to building the enterprise playbook, refining our GTM approach as we scale Provide accurate forecasts and deliver consistently against quota How to be successful in this role: 7+ years in a closing Account Executive role, with at least 5 years selling enterprise B2B SaaS Recent experience at a cybersecurity, compliance automation, infrastructure, or IT operations software company Proven ability to consistently meet/exceed quota, including managing 5+ six-figure deals per quarter Strong outbound prospecting skills and ability to independently build a robust pipeline Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles Executive presence with the ability to engage and influence C-level buyers Experience working both direct and via channel partners Technically conversant enough to build credibility with security and IT leaders Highly consultative with a customer-first mindset and a track record of long-term value delivery Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments Aligned with Vanta’s mission to secure and protect customer dataOpen to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office Family planning benefits Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time 11 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. #LI-remote At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world’s leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. content.title: Senior Identity Security Engineer (Remote - LATAM) at Atmosera

Understanding of Zero Trust security principles and Microsoft security best practices. Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Certifications (SC-300, SC-200, AZ-500, SC-100) CISSP or equivalent security certification Experience with Microsoft Purview, CyberArk, SailPoint, or Okta Experience supporting enterprise security and compliance initiatives This is a contractor position with the ability to work from home but may require travel to a client site. content.title: Senior Manager, Commercial Systems at EnableComp
content.description: WHO WE ARE EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence™ (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform.Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity, Ecstatic Clients, and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun—celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance. POSITION SUMMARY The Senior Manager, Commercial Systems is responsible for owning and evolving the commercial systems that power EnableComp’s go-to-market engine — Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, and Accord. This role treats the commercial stack as a product: a connected operating system that should get smarter, faster, and more automated every quarter, not just kept running. The ideal candidate is the owner and steward of how EnableComp’s revenue systems talk to each other, and increasingly, how AI does the connecting — using tools like Claude to redesign workflows and reduce manual work across the commercial organization, not just administer existing configuration. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Serve as platform owner for Salesforce (system of record), HubSpot (marketing/demand gen), Gong (conversation intelligence), Clay (data enrichment/workflow automation), and Accord (mutual action plans/deal execution). Partner with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and Client Success leadership to prioritize the systems roadmap and translate business requirements into technical specs and developer handoffs. Develop and maintain the integration design across these tools — object models, data flows, triggers, and automations — so information moves cleanly from first touch to closed-won to renewal. Analyze and translate GTM strategy into system design: new motions, territory or segmentation changes, and reporting needs all become clean, scalable configuration, not spaghetti workarounds. Lead the use of AI (Claude and similar tools) as a core part of how the team works — building AI-assisted workflows, automations, and internal tools that reduce manual admin work across the commercial org. Conduct data integrity and governance reviews across the stack: field standards, deduplication, permissioning, and audit-readiness. Coordinate dashboards and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and rep performance. Evaluate and pilot new RevTech and AI capabilities, building the business case and rollout plan for anything recommended. Identify and manage the systems side of the deal lifecycle — pipeline stages, forecasting categories, quoting/CPQ-adjacent workflows, and MAP/mutual-close-plan tooling via Accord. REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered) 5+ years administering or managing Salesforce in a commercial/RevOps context (certifications a plus, not required) Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Gong, and ideally Clay and/or Accord (or clearly transferable tools in the same category) Real, demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build workflows, automate tasks, or transform how a system or team operates — not just casual use Strong SQL/SOQL or equivalent query fluency, and comfort translating messy business asks into clean data models Experience writing technical specs and partnering with developers or implementation vendors to ship system changes Excellent cross-functional communication skills; healthcare, RCM, or complex B2B sales environment experience is a plus Timely and regular attendance. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES Minimal travel required (occasional on-site collaboration or team events). Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, evolving environment. A product mindset — comfortable owning a roadmap, prioritizing competing requests, and iterating based on feedback; genuine curiosity about applying AI to eliminate manual, repetitive work Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission. EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment. EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry’s top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success , and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you. Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our people are saying: _“I love my job because everyone shares the same vision and is determined and dedicated. People care about you as a person and your professional growth. content.description: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS: If you’ve already completed the 20four7VA Recruiting Process—including the Final Interview—or have previously been contracted by a 20four7VA Client, please make sure to apply via the 20four7VA Team Portal for faster processing. If you’re interested in this opportunity, click APPLY TO POSITION to proceed. \*\*\****************************************************************** Title: CPT-11493 Executive Operations & Business Support Virtual Assistant Independent Contractor – CPT-11493 Executive Operations & Business Support Virtual Assistant/Business Support VA/Junior Senior Level (Remote). Overview 20four7VA is seeking offshore independent contractors to deliver remote services to clients worldwide, with a primary focus on developed markets such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia. A growing non-medical in-home care agency in Orange County, California, is seeking a part-time Executive Operations & Business Support Virtual Assistant to support the owner and Operations Manager with recurring executive, administrative, organizational, CRM, follow-up, research, and operational responsibilities. The owner spends significant time in the community developing referral relationships, building partnerships, and growing the business. The VA’s primary purpose is to keep the owner organized, maintain accurate business information, track commitments and follow-ups, and ensure important administrative responsibilities do not fall through the cracks. This role requires a highly organized, proactive, forward-thinking professional who can learn the business, exercise sound judgment, communicate appropriately on behalf of the owner, and independently bring assigned responsibilities to completion once trained. PRIMARY ROLE PRIORITIES During the initial 60–90 days, the VA’s primary focus will be executive organization, CRM maintenance, task tracking, follow-up management, and administrative support. Research, recruiting support, and outbound outreach will be secondary responsibilities and may expand as the VA demonstrates proficiency with the core role. Executive organization and follow-through Calendar, email, task, and deadline management CRM accuracy and follow-up tracking Operations and administrative support Referral-source and community-partner research Outbound follow-up and communication, as assigned Caregiver recruiting administration, as assigned The objective of each engagement is to assist the client in improving business efficiency, enhancing service delivery, or supporting operational functions through high-quality, task-specific services rendered by a qualified contractor. Scope of Services Contractors will be required to provide services that align with the following client tasks: Executive & Administrative Support Manage the owner’s calendar, coordinate meetings, prevent scheduling conflicts, prepare the owner for upcoming appointments, and help protect time for business development and other high-value activities. Monitor and organize the owner’s business email, identify messages requiring action, draft routine responses when appropriate, track unanswered or pending communications, and help ensure important messages receive timely follow-up. Track outstanding tasks, commitments, deadlines, and promised follow-ups. Provide proactive reminders and concise updates on items requiring owner attention or decisions. Maintain organized administrative records, files, meeting notes, and task trackers. Work closely with the Operations Manager on recurring internal tasks while following clearly assigned priorities and ownership. Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and bring tasks to completion without requiring repeated reminders from the owner. CRM & Business Operations Maintain accurate and current CRM records. Track outreach activity, contacts, referral sources, next steps, and follow-up requirements. Research referral sources, community partners, senior-service organizations, healthcare contacts, and other potential business relationships. Organize prospect, referral, and community-partner information. Support basic caregiver recruiting administration, candidate tracking, and follow-up as directed. Maintain business records, spreadsheets, databases, and operational trackers. Identify incomplete records, overdue follow-ups, or administrative gaps and proactively bring them to the appropriate team member’s attention. Outreach & Communication Conduct occasional outbound calls, emails, or follow-up communications using approved messaging and guidance. Represent the company and owner professionally when communicating with referral partners, community contacts, caregiver candidates, vendors, and other outside contacts. Conduct basic information-gathering conversations and ask thoughtful follow-up questions rather than relying solely on a script. Document conversations, outcomes, next steps, and follow-up dates in the appropriate system. Escalate qualified opportunities, sensitive matters, clinical questions, complaints, or issues requiring management attention. Weekly Executive Support Report: Prepare a concise weekly executive support summary for the owner and Operations Manager that may include: Open owner action items and decisions needed Follow-ups due or overdue Referral and outreach activity Important upcoming appointments and deadlines CRM items requiring attention Recruiting or administrative issues Items awaiting responses from outside contacts Recommended priorities for the upcoming week AI & Productivity Tools Use approved AI and productivity tools to improve efficiency in research, drafting, summarization, task organization, meeting preparation, and routine administrative work. Apply appropriate judgment when using AI and never enter protected, confidential, or sensitive information into unapproved systems. Review AI-generated work for accuracy, professionalism, and appropriateness before it is used or shared. Confidentiality & Compliance Handle client, caregiver, employee, referral-partner, and business information discreetly. Follow established privacy, cybersecurity, and data-handling procedures. Complete HIPAA training/certification before handling applicable protected or sensitive information. Avoid providing medical advice, making clinical decisions, or acting outside the agency’s non-medical scope. Immediately escalate privacy, compliance, or sensitive client/caregiver concerns to the appropriate internal team member. Each engagement is based on a defined scope of work and is governed by an independent contractor agreement. Services must be performed professionally, with adherence to any timelines, guidelines, and deliverables agreed upon in writing. Skills The Contractor must demonstrate proficiency in the following, depending on the Client’s requirements: Previous executive assistant, operations support, administrative coordination, or similar experience required. Mid-level to senior-level experience strongly preferred. CRM management experience preferred. Strong calendar, email, task-management, and follow-up experience. Customer service or professional business communication experience strongly preferred. Strong spoken and written English required. Home care, healthcare, senior services, professional services, or a similar industry is a plus but not required. Recruiting, referral-development, lead-management, or business-development support experience is a plus. Experience using AI tools for administrative productivity is preferred. HIPAA training/certification may be required. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE Extremely organized, dependable, and detail-oriented Proactive and forward-thinking, with the ability to anticipate next steps Strong executive-assistant, operations-support, or administrative coordination background Professional, confident, and conversational on the phone Able to ask thoughtful questions and understand the purpose behind an assignment Comfortable independently following through and closing the loop on tasks Able to prioritize competing responsibilities and identify what requires immediate attention Strong written communication and documentation skills Able to work effectively with both the owner and Operations Manager Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive information Comfortable learning new software, systems, processes, and AI-enabled productivity tools KEY OUTCOMES / MEASURES OF SUCCESS: The VA will be successful when the owner spends less time managing administrative details, CRM information remains current, follow-ups occur consistently, commitments are tracked through completion, and the owner and Operations Manager have clear visibility into outstanding priorities. Important commitments and follow-ups are consistently captured and completed on time. The owner’s calendar and business email are organized and actionable. CRM and referral-source records remain accurate and current. The owner receives timely reminders and concise information needed to make decisions. Assigned responsibilities are completed with decreasing levels of supervision as the VA becomes trained. Outside contacts receive professional, timely communication. The VA identifies administrative gaps and potential issues before they become problems. The owner is able to spend more time on relationship development, referral generation, community engagement, and business growth. APPLICATION SOFTWARE KNOWLEDGE / REQUIRED CRM platforms Calendar and email platforms Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace Business phone / VoIP systems Task-management and productivity tools AI productivity tools Client-specific home care and business systems – training provided Work Schedule Contracted Hours per Week: 10 Hours (may increase toward 15–20 hours/week as responsibilities grow) Scheduled Working Days: Monday through Friday (unless otherwise mutually agreed in writing) Daily Working Time: Flexible Pacific Time business hours – TBD Note: The Company will make reasonable efforts to align the Assigned VA’s schedule with the Client’s preferred hours as set forth above. However, availability may vary based on time zones, capacity, and the contracted hours set in this SOW. Any changes must be mutually agreed to in writing through a revised SOW. REGION PREFERENCES: Any What we offer Competitive rates Weekly payments Various open roles are available Free training and upskilling Constant support and guidance A vibrant community always ready to support you And more!

content.title: Art Director at OpenAI
content.description: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make surethe work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told,in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Art Director to join our in-house creative team. In this role, you’ll concept and direct high-impact, multi-channel campaigns that elevate OpenAI’s brand and communicate the capabilities, benefits, and ethical considerations of our technology. You’ll partner closely with writers, designers, marketers, product leads, and external vendors to produce visually stunning work- from key visuals and web experiences to video storyboards, product trailers, and live event creative. To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance craft with decisiveness. This role is based in New York with periodic travel to other OpenAI offices. In this role, you will Lead the creative development of marketing campaigns, product launches, and brand moments - from concept to final execution Develop and direct compelling visual narratives that bring OpenAI’s story and products to life Translate abstract ideas and complex technology into clear, inspiring, and elegant visual communication Collaborate with writers, designers, brand strategists, product marketing, and external creative partners Provide visual direction for campaign photography, illustration, and video - sometimes hands-on, sometimes through external vendors Establish and maintain a high visual bar across all marketing outputs, ensuring consistency with OpenAI’s evolving brand identity Contribute to the evolution of OpenAI’s brand system in ways that are scalable, distinctive, and expressive You might thrive in this role if you Have 10+ years of experience as an Art Director at in-house or at a top-tier creative agency, with a portfolio that shows work for modern technology brands Bring a strong background in visual design with fluency across channels - digital, social, film, print, and experiential Are a conceptual thinker who can ideate strategically and visually across formats and campaigns Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, and have experience scaling ideas under tight timelines Are passionate about design craft and committed to building systems and stories that elevate brand presence over time Value collaboration and feedback, and thrive in cross-functional environments with marketing, design, and product teams Nice to Have Experience working with or designing for AI, developer tools, or emerging technologies Motion design or video art direction experience Comfort giving creative direction in Figma, Google Slides, or on-set About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. A client is seeking a full-time Virtual Assistant with hands-on experience in affiliate arbitrage to help build, launch, and optimize a newly acquired affiliate marketing business using an established training program and its provided tools, templates, systems, and support resources. content.title: Sales Development Representative at Versapay
content.description: About Versapay 🚀 Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage. Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward. Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually. Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!! How you’ll make a huge impact here – and on your career: This is your chance to step into the competitive and lucrative world of technology sales. Here, you’ll get experience selling to senior level execs in finance across a wide array of industries. And you’ll do that across North America. You’ll be mentored by other Versapay salespeople who have a ton of experience – you could literally be working with someone with 5 – 15+ years of crushing quotas at some of the world’s leading tech companies. What you’ll do: Being the first point of contact for Versapay in the customer value journey. Qualifying contacted customers for continued engagement with our sales teams. Evaluating their clear understanding of the problems we solve and their readiness to address these issues. Proactively prospect new potential customers through phone, email and social media outlets, with the goal of making contact and creating interest in Versapay, with a target of scheduling deeper discovery calls for the sales team. Join a team that is invested in your future. We’ll provide training and work with you on building out your career path here. You will have exposure to learning about and working with teams across the business, including but not limited to Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Enablement and Marketing. By researching accounts, contacts, key players, etc. you’re not only able to generate and stimulate buying interest with lead nurturing, emails and building collateral/assets to share, but successfully manage and overcome objections. Document your success in Salesforce Lightning CRM and ensure data in marketing automation is complete and up to date. Learn, teach others and advance within the sales organization, first by building pipeline and gaining exposure to all aspects of a sales cycle, working together to improve lead quality, collab on best practices and hone your craft. Work in lockstep with the marketing team and support lead gen programs from pre-program planning to data entry and post follow-up and tracking. And when possible, helping with tradeshow/event logistics and support. Contribute to our awesome culture! Make Versapay a great place to learn, grow and accelerate careers! Your voice matters and we always test and try before we go all in on the Sales team. What you’ll bring to the team: 2-5 years of experience in a BDR/SDR or equivalent sales role You have a proven track record of generating an outbound pipeline from scratch. Cold calls, cold emails, social selling, and creative prospecting are second nature to you, not afterthoughts. You’re a skilled multi-threader. You instinctively engage multiple stakeholders across an account simultaneously, mapping buying committees and building champions at every level of an organization. You’ve consistently hit or exceeded outbound-specific metrics, reaching 90%+ quota attainment. Whether that’s meetings booked, pipeline generated, or sequences launched, you’ve got the numbers to back it up. You’re naturally curious and confident. You ask sharp questions, listen actively, and know how to tailor your message to different personas, from a CFO to a Head of Procurement. You have strong business acumen and understand that every prospect has a unique problem. You listen, discern, and connect the dots between their pain and our solution. You bring great energy that people gravitate toward, with strong written and verbal communication skills that cut through the noise in a crowded inbox or on a cold call. You have a bias toward action. You don’t wait for inbound, you go find the pipeline yourself. You thrive in fast-moving, evolving environments and adapt your approach without losing momentum. You’re collaborative and coachable. You’ll partner closely with AEs on account and territory planning and raise the bar for the SDRs around you. You’re proficient with sales tools like Gong, Salesforce, or Sales Navigator and know how to build and optimize sequences that actually convert. Bonus: Experience selling into the office of the CFO is a big plus. You understand the compliance considerations, buying cycles, and stakeholder complexity that come with the territory. $50,000 - $55,250 a year Can earn up to 85K CAD OTE #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. content.title: Senior Talent Specialist at CookUnity
content.description: About CookUnity: Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Team At CookUnity, Talent is at the core of how we scale with intention. As part of our growing Talent Acquisition team, you’ll join a tight-knit, high-impact group that values ownership, excellence, and strong partnerships . We act as strategic advisors to the business , identifying and attracting exceptional talent that aligns with our values and drives our mission forward. We’re a people-first, product-led company that moves fast and stays focused on making an impact—together. This is a hybrid role—primarily remote, but we come together in our Palermo office a few days each month for in-person collaboration, connection, and some fun! The Role We’re looking for a Senior Talent Specialist to lead high-impact searches across Product, Data, and Go-to-Market (GTM) functions, primarily supporting hiring in the U.S. and LATAM. The portfolio will include senior individual contributor, leadership, and executive-level positions. This is not a sourcing-only role . We’re looking for someone who can own searches end-to-end, shape recruiting strategy, influence decisions, and deliver outstanding candidate and hiring manager experiences. You’ll join at a key moment in our growth and help define what great hiring looks like at CookUnity. Responsibilites Own the end-to-end recruiting process for high-impact roles across Product, Data, and GTM, including senior leadership and executive searches. Act as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers and leaders, bringing structured processes, market insights, and strategic recommendations. Lead effective intake meetings, define search strategies, and translate business needs into clear candidate profiles and assessment plans. Build strong pipelines through proactive sourcing and outreach , using tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Greenhouse, Gem, and AI-enabled recruiting tools. Champion the candidate experience and ensure a thoughtful, consistent interview process from first contact through close. Lead interviewer calibration, debriefs, and structured decision-making to support inclusive, high-quality hires. Partner closely with stakeholders across the U.S. and LATAM, adapting recruiting strategies to each market while maintaining a consistent hiring bar. Lead offer management and negotiation with empathy, transparency, and speed. Use data and market intelligence to identify bottlenecks, track progress, and continuously improve hiring outcomes. Contribute to employer branding and talent marketing initiatives that help CookUnity stand out in competitive markets. Qualifications: 5+ years of Talent Acquisition experience: A proven track record of sourcing and recruiting candidates across different functions. Relevant functional expertise: Demonstrated success recruiting for Product and Data roles , as well as GTM functions such as Growth, Marketing, Sales, and Strategic Partnerships. Full-cycle recruiting: Strong experience managing searches end to end, preferably in an in-house environment. U.S. and LATAM market experience: Prior experience hiring in both regions, including recruiting for U.S.-headquartered companies and partnering closely with U.S.-based hiring managers. Senior stakeholder partnership: Confidence advising hiring managers and senior leaders while providing hands-on operational support. Exceptional communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with advanced or bilingual English proficiency . ATS fluency: Proficiency with applicant tracking systems; we use Greenhouse. Prioritization skills: The ability to manage competing priorities and multiple searches effectively. Startup mindset: A proactive, resourceful, make-things-happen attitude and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Leadership potential: Enthusiasm for growing into a leadership role as the company expands. Ability to leverage generative AI to increase output quality and speed. Analytical, motivated, quick to learn, adept at multitasking, and resourceful. Preferred Requirements Market awareness: A deep understanding of industry trends and talent market dynamics, with the ability to proactively adjust recruiting strategies. Employer branding: Experience developing employer branding strategies that attract top talent and strengthen the company’s reputation as an employer of choice. Why CookUnity? We’re a profitable, mission-driven company passionate about transforming mealtime with chef-crafted, personalized meals. We value excellence, ownership, and relationships—and we’re growing fast. Learn more about how we work: 👉 CookUnity’s Leadership Principles If this resonates with you, we’d love to connect! Benefits 💸 Get paid in USD 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date 🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays 🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider 🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical 🐣 Paid Family leave 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises 🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform 🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster. 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we’ll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability. A quick note for all candidates We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us: Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page. We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

content.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Data Management at Versapay
content.description: About Versapay Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end- to-end cash flow clarity, ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms. By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually. About the Role We are looking for a strategic, builder-minded Senior Director of Enterprise Data Management to own and execute Versapay’s enterprise data strategy at a pivotal moment in our evolution. This leader will drive the convergence of our transactional, operational, behavioral, relational and intent data layers into a unified operational backbone — the foundational unlock for AI- powered product features, semantic data models, externalized data products, and autonomous AR workflows. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role directly tied to our product and commercial roadmap, with a clear mandate and executive alignment behind it. What You’ll Do Data Strategy & Architecture Define and drive Versapay’s enterprise data strategy, aligning the data roadmap to product, AI, and commercial objectives. Lead the architectural convergence of our transactional, operational, and analytical data layers into a unified, bi-directional operational backbone. Own a multi-year data maturity roadmap with clear milestones across architecture, semantics, governance, and accessibility. Champion a business-first data modelling philosophy: canonical hierarchies, enterprise ontologies, and shared metric catalogues that allow humans and AI agents to interpret data consistently. Data Governance & Quality Operationalize data governance as a first-class concern — automated classification, RBAC enforcement, platform SLAs, and certified data objects. Formalize the Enterprise Data Catalogue, replacing institutional knowledge with a searchable, self-service discovery layer. Deploy and maintain an executive data health dashboard to provide ongoing visibility into the health and integrity of our data estate. Enforce the data procurement gate, ensuring new tools and systems are reviewed and classified before entering the estate. Build and own the Enterprise Data Asset Registry to enable secure, frictionless data sharing internally and with commercial partners. AI Enablement & Agentic Readiness Drive data infrastructure readiness to support Versapay’s AI roadmap — from ML pipelines and LLM serving layers to agentic serving tiers. Establish formal schema contracts and semantic modelling standards that guarantee deterministic outputs for safe, scalable agent deployment. Partner with Product and Engineering to enable agentic capabilities: reverse data flow, predictive model productization, and real-time data serving. Govern data and AI exposure — ensuring sensitive data stays within approved platforms and all external data products meet strict quality, lineage, and privacy standards. Data Accessibility & Commercialization Evolve the function from ad hoc data requests to a design-first, product-oriented organization with a governed, discoverable asset registry. Operationalize external data products for commercialization, delivering clear value to customers within consent and compliance frameworks. Partner with the commercial team on data product strategy — turning Versapay’s proprietary network data into defensible, recurring revenue. Expand self-service data access for internal teams while protecting compute capacity and governance standards. Team Leadership Lead and grow the Data Platform Team, building a high-performing function with clear ownership across data strategy, engineering, consumption, AI compute; in tight partnership with the Embedded Analytics Team, Risk and Compliance. Act as the cross-functional bridge between Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and Legal/Compliance- ensuring data serves every function from a shared, trusted foundation. Build a culture of data discipline — standardizing how information is captured and governed so insight is consistent, discoverable, and trusted across the organization. Represent the data function at the executive level, partnering closely with the CTO and contributing to the broader AI and product roadmap. What You Bring Required • 10+ years of experience in data leadership, with at least 5+ years at the Director level owning enterprise data strategy, architecture, or governance. • Demonstrated track record of modernizing and unifying complex, multi-source data environments at scale — ideally in a SaaS, fintech, payments context. • Deep expertise in modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred), lakehouse architectures, ETL frameworks, and semantic/canonical modelling. • Strong evidence of application of AI and ML infrastructure — including how data governance, observability, and semantic standards underpin safe, scalable AI deployment. • Proven ability to build and lead high-performing technical teams and partner effectively across Product, Engineering, and Commercial functions. • Experience governing data for commercial use: external data products, consent frameworks, lineage standards, and privacy compliance. • Exceptional communication skills — able to translate complex data and architectural concepts for executive audiences and build alignment across functions. • Experience with managing the cost of data warehouses and cost forecasting. • Experience in hiring and managing talent across the entire data food chain – from BI and Analytics to Data Engineering to CI/CD of data platforms. Preferred • Experience with agentic AI architecture, MCP, or LLM serving layers and the data requirements that underpin them. • Familiarity with AR/AP automation, payments, or working capital platforms and the data models they generate. • Track record of commercializing data as a product — packaging data assets, building external APIs, or creating data-sharing programs with partners. • Experience managing data maturity transformations with structured roadmaps, measurable milestones, and executive visibility. • Hands-on experience with AWS-native data infrastructure (Glue, SageMaker, Bedrock) alongside Snowflake and modern BI tooling. • Background in a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS environment. $180,000 - $220,000 a year We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

content.title: Division Principal Game Programmer (Unreal Engine, AI) at Gameloft
content.description: Job Description WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​ What you will focus on This role exists because reactive execution is no longer enough. The OTT programming division needs a technical authority who can shift the team’s positioning from “a team that delivers what it is asked to build” to “a technical partners that other studios actively seek out because of the value it brings to a game’s success.” That shift requires someone who can set a long-term technical vision, build scalable production ecosystems across mobile, PC, and console, and drive focused R&D including applied AI in game development, while simultaneously ensuring flawless deliveries across multiple live and co-development projects. The real challenge is dual: you are building toward the future while keeping current production healthy. You will need to anticipate what partner studios will need before they ask, identify and close skill gaps across a team of around 35 to 40 programmers, and establish the kind of technical standards that make this studio a reference point across the organization, not just a capable executor. What it means on a daily basis​ Monitor the technical health of multiple concurrent projects, working closely with technical leads to surface risks early, prevent bottlenecks, and keep deliveries on track across live service and co-development titles. Define and enforce studio-wide coding standards, architectural patterns, and engineering workflows, and drive their adoption across programming teams. Lead high-impact R&D initiatives, with particular focus on AI applied to game development, and ensure successful integration of outcomes into production pipelines through documentation, prototypes, and structured handoffs. Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentoring to senior programmers, leads, and high-potential contributors, conducting periodic competency assessments and building clear development paths toward future technical experts. Act as the primary technical counterpart for co-development partner studios, aligning on architecture, tooling, style guides, and Unreal toolchain standardization across shared pipelines. Collaborate cross-functionally with Game Design, Art, and Production to improve how programming integrates with other disciplines and contributes to overall product quality. Strategic resource planning and project allocation in partnership with the Studio Technical Director. What success will look like​ Within your first year, you will have made a visible and assessable impact on at least one co-development project or on a strategic technical mission defined in alignment with the studio’s long-term vision. That impact will be confirmed through calibration with multiple stakeholders across the organization, not through self-assessment alone. Who you would be working with​ You will report to the Studio Technical Director and operate across a programming department of around 35 to 40 people, spanning multiple seniority levels and allocated to live service and co-development projects on mobile, PC, and console platforms. Internally, your key collaborators include department heads and team leads across Game Design, Art, and Production, as well as Studio Directors and the Studio Manager. Externally, you will work directly with Technical Managers and Technical Directors from co-development partner studios. Your recruitment journey Screen Call with a Recruiter (up to 30 minutes) First Interview with the Studio Technical Director and Division Principal/Manager (up to 90 minutes) Second Interview with Studio Manager and HR Director (up to 60 minutes) Final interview with a Technical Director from a sister studio (up to 60 minutes) Where this role can take you If the opportunity arises and the qualifications are in place, this position is a direct pathway to the Studio Technical Director role. That outcome is not guaranteed, but it is a realistic evolution for the right person. Qualifications WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED​ Proven hands-on expertise in game development across multiple genres and platforms, including both mobile and PC/console, with deep command of Unreal Engine 5 at an architectural level. Demonstrated ability to design and lead large-scale technical systems, covering areas such as 3D rendering, AI gameplay systems, online and network scalability, and cloud infrastructure, with proficiency in C++ and at least one additional language such as C# or Python. Practical experience deploying AI and LLM-based tools in a production context, including hands-on use of AI coding assistants integrated into active development pipelines. A track record of leading R&D initiatives from exploration through to production integration, including delivering whitepapers, technical specifications, or mature prototypes that shaped how a team ships games. Demonstrated leadership of multi-disciplinary programming teams, including identifying skill gaps, building development plans for technical contributors, and raising the collective output quality of a department rather than just individual projects. The ability to communicate technical direction clearly to senior leadership, partner studio counterparts, and non-technical collaborators, and to influence decisions at a strategic level while maintaining alignment across stakeholders. You are comfortable working in English as your primary professional language, including writing technical documentation, leading meetings, and collaborating with international partners and stakeholders. WHO YOU ARE You think in systems and timelines. When a production problem lands on your desk, you resolve it without losing sight of the architectural implications and the upstream conditions that caused it. You set direction rather than wait for it. You anticipate what teams and partners will need technically before they articulate the ask, and you build toward that proactively. You lead by raising the floor. Developing technical talent, closing skill gaps, and creating conditions where senior programmers grow into future experts matters as much to you as the quality of your own technical output. You hold your ground in complex stakeholder environments. Whether aligning with partner studio leadership, pushing back on a technical shortcut, or navigating competing priorities, you communicate with clarity and bring people with you rather than around you. You are hands-on by choice, not obligation. You engage directly with the most complex and strategic technical challenges because you know that credibility in this role is built in the work, not only in the meeting room. You balance technical rigor with product thinking. You understand that code quality, security, performance, and compliance are not constraints on creativity; they are the conditions that make it sustainable. You remain steady when conditions shift. Reorganizations, new co-development mandates, and changing production priorities do not destabilize your approach; they sharpen it. Additional Information WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Benefits A hybrid working model with 2 days working from home every week. A range of well-being events and policies to support employees physically, mentally, and emotionally. Various training packages, including internal training, training sponsorship, and e-learning platforms (iLearn, Udemy, O’Reilly,…). Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourself. An attractive monthly salary alongside Tet and other performance bonuses. Minimum 12 days of paid annual leave, plus 5 days of paid sick leave, Christmas leave, Birthday leave, CSR leave,… 100% coverage of mandatory insurance plus private healthcare insurance. A monthly allowance to support lunch meals and working-from-home electricity and Internet bills. Relocation supprt for international candidates joining from overseas. Life at Gameloft A collaborative workplace environment, with over 15+ nationalities, where hundreds of world-renowned game titles were born. An open-space office, a canteen, a billiard table, a ping-pong table, and a foosball table. A gaming room equipped with mutiple devices (PS, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, arcade machine,…). A capable and encouraging team of professionals focused on creating compelling video games. A global company where you can meet great people around the world. A fun place to work in the heart of the city. How to proceed Ready to level up your career? Apply now and help us create the next great game! Please note: To ensure a fair and compliant recruitment process under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), please submit your application through the official job posting, preferably via Gameloft website, Gameloft or Gameloft Vietnam LinkedIn pages, or SmartRecruiters. Applications sent via email or LinkedIn messages will not be considered. Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates whose profiles most closely match the role needs will be contacted by our recruiters. We sincerely appreciate your understanding and interest. What’s more? Want to know more? Visit our websites: Saigon Studio website LinkedIn page Facebook page Check out some projects at Saigon Studio: Dungeons & Dragons® Asphalt 8 - Coin Rush Trailer Asphalt Legends Unite - Launch Trailer Applaydu Season 6 Bluey’s Happy Snaps

content.title: Creative Director, Brand at Chime

You will lead a small in-house team of art directors, designers and copywriters, and direct the external agencies, production companies and partners who help scale the work. You should be comfortable pitching bold top-of-funnel brand work while understanding how the rest of the funnel earns it: campaigns that build awareness, move consideration and support conversion, and that stay honestly connected to what the business needs. In this role, you can expect to Set and evolve the creative vision for the Chime brand, and translate it into storytelling that drives awareness and consideration Lead integrated campaigns end to end — from platform and concept through production and final execution — across brand film and broadcast, social, partnerships, activations and owned channels Champion bold ideas, and make the case for them clearly to marketing, product and executive stakeholders Build creative that travels: social-first thinking, talent and partner collaborations, and moments designed to be shared rather than served Partner with brand, growth, product marketing and media leads so that campaign ideas hold up across the full funnel and are measurable against business goals Lead, mentor and grow a team of art directors, designers and copywriters, and set the standard for the quality of work the team ships Run creative reviews and brainstorms that raise the level of the idea, with clear direction and feedback people can act on Manage external creative agencies, production houses, and media and talent partners, and hold them to the same bar Use the tools that make a modern creative team faster — problem, the idea, and what happened At least one brand platform you built or meaningfully shaped that changed how people saw a company Experience in a creative agency environment, and the craft standard that comes with it Work that has run in more than one form: brand film or broadcast produced with agency and production partners, social-native work, and partnership or activation initiatives content.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Platform at Chime
content.description: About the role Chime’s Machine Learning Platform (MLP) team builds and operates the infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience that powers machine learning across the company. We enable data scientists and ML engineers to develop, train, deploy, and monitor models reliably and efficiently. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Machine Learning Platform team, you will design and build scalable systems spanning traditional machine learning and emerging AI workloads, including model training, feature computation, real-time inference, foundation-model access, evaluation, and agentic orchestration. You’ll work at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, applied machine learning, and AI product engineering. This role focuses on creating secure, reliable, and reusable platform capabilities that help teams choose the right approach, from conventional predictive models to LLM-powered and multi-step agentic systems, while maintaining strong standards for evaluation, observability, governance, privacy, and cost efficiency. The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $187,000.00 and up to $259,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience. In this role, you can expect to Design, build, and operate scalable ML and AI infrastructure on AWS. Design and operate shared platform capabilities for LLM and agentic workloads, including model access, prompt and configuration lifecycle, retrieval, tool integration, state management, and workflow orchestration. Build evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems, including offline benchmarks, regression testing, online quality signals, human feedback, and failure analysis. Establish observability, reliability, and governance for models and agents, covering traces, model and prompt versions, tool calls, latency, token usage, quality, safety, privacy, and cost. Help teams make principled architecture decisions across traditional ML, LLM-powered applications, and agentic workflows, and contribute to the platform’s technical roadmap. Build distributed training, batch inference, and large-scale processing systems using frameworks such as Ray or Spark. Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform. Support and evolve the feature store and feature pipelines. Develop data ingestion and streaming systems using technologies such as Kinesis, Kafka, Flink, or Spark. Improve CI/CD workflows for ML models, AI applications, and platform components. Partner closely with Data Science and ML Engineering teams to improve developer experience. Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems. To thrive in this role, you have Knowledge of the machine learning development lifecycle, including data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Experience designing distributed systems and large-scale data or compute platforms on AWS using frameworks such as Spark or Ray. 5+ years of experience in ML or AI infrastructure, platform engineering, distributed systems, or production ML systems. Working knowledge of LLM application patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool calling, agent orchestration, and evaluation of non-deterministic systems. Experience designing production systems that integrate ML or foundation models through reliable APIs, workflows, and data contracts. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and infrastructure as code. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Strong programming skills in Python, Go, Scala, Java, or similar languages. Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, code review, and observability. Nice-to-have Experience shipping LLM-powered or agentic systems to production. Experience with one or more of the following: model gateways, prompt lifecycle management, retrieval or vector search, tool execution, and agent orchestration frameworks. Experience building evaluation, tracing, and observability capabilities for non-deterministic AI systems. Familiarity with managed or self-hosted foundation model infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or equivalent platforms.
