With Life360’s rapid growth and strong business momentum, we have a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact at global scale. At the heart of our mission is a dedication to helping families feel safe, connected, and cared for through the transformative power of design. The Growth Revenue Experimentation team (within the Product Design team) is the engine behind Life360’s subscription revenue growth: we turn ideas about pricing, packaging, and the paywall funnel into fast, validated experiments. We run a high volume of tests across the entire subscription funnel - driving free users to start a trial, trial to paid conversion & churn prevention. Additionally, optimizing the top-performing features to drive further conversion, SKU and pricing routing, external billing, and churn and win-back, partnering closely with the Revenue ML team to personalize offers and target the right SKU to the right user. We set and hold the bar for experiment quality and methodology across the program, using tools like Statsig to run and govern testing at scale, and we ground every decision in research and data, validating or killing assumptions before they become a build. We are also an AI-native team: AI tooling is already speeding up how we generate hypotheses, build, and measure results, and we expect that velocity to keep climbing as our own workflows get faster too. About the Job We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer II to join our Revenue Experimentation team and help drive Life360’s growth through fast, high-quality design experimentation. This role sits at the intersection of product design, growth strategy, and data-informed decision-making, you’ll design, test, and iterate on experiences across our subscription and monetization surfaces to uncover new ways to grow revenue and deliver value to families. You’ll partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Content to turn loosely defined ideas into well-scoped tests, and well-scoped tests into learnings that shape our roadmap. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast without sacrificing craft, and wants their design decisions to directly and measurably impact the business. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $152k to $223k USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $176k to $207k CAD. We take into consideration an individual’s background and experience in determining final salary - therefore, base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes a wide range of medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits, as well as equity. What You’ll Do Design and run a high volume of experiments across Life360’s revenue and monetization surfaces, from trial conversion, trial-to-paid conversion to pricing, SKU routing, and churn/win-back. Turn loosely defined experiment briefs into well-scoped, testable hypotheses, using research and data to validate or challenge the underlying assumptions. Lead design for experiments that originate from your own ideas, and act as a critical, PM-partnering voice on ideas that originate elsewhere. Partner with Data Science and Analytics to define success metrics, interpret experiment results, and translate learnings into follow-on hypotheses. Present experiment concepts, in-flight learnings, and results to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of product design experience, ideally with exposure to growth, experimentation, or subscription/monetization design. A track record of shipping and iterating on A/B or multivariate experiments in a fast-paced, high-velocity environment. Comfort operating with ambiguity, able to take a loosely defined brief and turn it into a well-scoped, testable hypothesis using research or data. A proactive, ideas-first mindset: someone who brings concepts to the table rather than waiting to be handed a fully-formed brief. Strong collaboration skills, able to both lead from your own ideas and constructively pressure-test others’, as a true creative and strategic partner to PMs. Experience partnering closely with engineers, content, and data science across the full experiment lifecycle, from concept to bug bash to results. Excellent organizational habits: clean, well-documented Figma files and clear, traceable rationale for design decisions. Fluency in Figma; familiarity with experimentation and analytics tooling (e.g., Optimizely, Amplitude, Statsig, or similar) is a plus. Comfort using AI tools to accelerate design and production work. Strong visual design craft, with hands-on animation skills. A portfolio that showcases experimentation work, problem framing, hypotheses, iteration, and measurable impact, not just polished final screens. Ways of Working Operates in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, balancing multiple experiments at once. Comfortable with ambiguity. Experiment briefs often start loosely defined, and it’s the designer’s job to validate the underlying problem (through research or data) and refine it into something well-scoped enough to actually test, confirming or challenging the original assumptions along the way. Contributes ideas proactively, including in regular ideation sessions focused on a specific theme, bringing forward experiment concepts, not just executing others’. Partners with PMs as a true collaborator: leads projects that originate from their own ideas, and acts as a critical partner on PM-originated ideas, pressure-testing them for UX soundness and product fit rather than simply executing. Collaborates across design and other departments when an experiment touches product areas outside their own, to keep the experience consistent and aligned. Keeps work organized and traceable: clean file structure, documented hypotheses and rationale, and clean, well-organized Figma files so anyone can see what’s being tested, what’s been done, and why. Involves engineers early in the design process to surface technical questions and constraints before they become blockers. Participates in bug bashes, testing experiments before launch to confirm the experience matches intent. Uses AI as a creative and productivity partner, leveraging skills, automation, and AI-generated illustrations or animations where it makes sense, to move faster and free up more time for craft. AI-Native Expectations Daily use: You embed AI in all your workflows and use it for real, substantive tasks, including research, analysis, drafting, prototyping, analytics and experimentation. Review and accountability for AI output: AI-generated outputs get the same level of care of as any of your deliverables. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity: We expect senior practitioners who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage: doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed. Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave. Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being. Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns. Learning & Development programs. Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment. Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers. Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Diversity We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying! #LI-Remote \_\_\__________________________________________________________________________

content.title: Director, Business Development – Biologics & Biomarkers at Celerion
content.description: Celerion is committed to swift, exceptional clinical research through translational medicine. Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get drugs to market faster. The Senior Director, Business Development – Biologics & Biomarkers is responsible for driving strategic growth of Celerion’s Bioanalytical Services business through the acquisition of new clients and programs within biologics, biomarkers, molecular and cellular bioanalysis, and other emerging therapeutic modalities. This is a national business development role focused on expanding Celerion’s presence with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies conducting patient-based clinical development, including oncology, immunology, rare disease, neuroscience, cell and gene therapy, and other specialty therapeutic areas. The position emphasizes organizations that have historically conducted limited or no business with Celerion because they do not primarily utilize healthy volunteer clinical studies. Operating as a highly technical commercial leader, this individual will combine scientific credibility with consultative selling to develop new client relationships, identify emerging opportunities, and position Celerion as a preferred bioanalytical partner. The role will play a significant part in building business for Celerion’s Phoenix and Lincoln bioanalytical laboratories and expanding the company’s biologics and biomarker portfolio. Because this position operates nationally and collaborates closely with regional Business Development teams, success requires exceptional communication, collaboration, and organizational maturity to effectively coordinate client ownership, maximize commercial opportunities, and support overall company growth. Essential Functions: Business Development Develop and execute a national business development strategy focused on biologics, biomarkers, molecular and cellular bioanalysis, and emerging therapeutic modalities. Identify, qualify, and secure new business opportunities with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies that are not currently significant Celerion clients. Build relationships with scientific and executive decision makers including bioanalytical scientists, translational medicine leaders, clinical pharmacologists, DMPK scientists, biomarker groups, procurement organizations, and executive leadership. Develop opportunities within sponsors conducting patient-based clinical trials, including oncology and other specialty therapeutic areas. Build and maintain a robust national opportunity pipeline with emphasis on new client acquisition. Scientific & Commercial Leadership Serve as a technical commercial resource capable of discussing bioanalytical strategies, assay technologies, biomarkers, ligand binding assays, immunogenicity, molecular assays, flow cytometry, PCR, cell-based assays, and other advanced bioanalytical capabilities. Partner closely with scientific leadership to develop client-specific solutions. Represent Celerion at scientific meetings, partnering conferences, and industry events. Maintain current knowledge of emerging therapeutic modalities, regulatory trends, and competitive offerings. Strategic Growth Support commercialization of Celerion’s expanded biologics and biomarker capabilities. Drive business growth supporting the Phoenix and Lincoln bioanalytical laboratories. Identify emerging market opportunities and provide competitive intelligence to commercial and operational leadership. Collaborate with Marketing on strategic campaigns supporting biologics and biomarker growth initiatives. Collaboration Work collaboratively with regional Business Development representatives to coordinate customer engagement and account ownership. Proactively communicate opportunities and resolve territory or account overlaps professionally. Partner with Operations, Scientific Affairs, Proposal Development, Contracts, and Executive Leadership to maximize customer success. Support a culture of teamwork where overall company growth takes priority over individual account ownership. Customer Relationship Management Maintain accurate sales forecasts and opportunity management within CRM. Develop strategic account plans for priority opportunities. Lead client meetings, scientific discussions, proposal strategy, and contract negotiations. Ensure exceptional customer experience throughout the sales process. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, or related scientific discipline required. Advanced scientific degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) preferred. Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible experience in pharmaceutical or CRO business development. Demonstrated success selling biologics, biomarkers, bioanalytical, translational medicine, or related laboratory services. Strong understanding of large molecule bioanalysis including ligand binding assays, immunogenicity, biomarkers, molecular assays, flow cytometry, PCR, and emerging therapeutic modalities. Established network within the biotechnology and pharmaceutical industry. Demonstrated ability to consistently generate new business through prospecting and relationship development. Experience selling consultative scientific services to technical decision makers. Excellent presentation, negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills. Ability to collaborate effectively across complex matrix organizations. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously. Willingness to travel extensively throughout the United States (approximately 50–70%). Strong preference for candidates with established relationships in West Coast and Northeast biotechnology markets. Celerion Values: Integrity Trust Teamwork Respect Celerion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, qualified protected veteran status, or disability. Note: To make sure you don’t miss important updates from us, please check your Spam folder for emails from @celerion.com, particularly interview invitations. If you find one there, mark it as “Not Junk” to ensure future Celerion emails land in your inbox. Please note that Gmail accounts have been particularly noted as routing to Spam. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. content.title: Director, Machine Learning at Narvar
content.description: Narvar is Growing! We’re looking for a leader to own the machine learning systems behind post-purchase commerce — identity, fraud, and the intelligence layer that agentic AI runs on. Hundreds of millions of consumers interact with Narvar every year, across 20B+ orders and 1,300+ retail brands. That data powers three systems: Graphite , our identity resolution engine that ties fragmented consumer data into a single verified identity across retailers; IRIS , our fraud and returns-abuse detection engine built on top of it. You’ll own the ML organization behind all of it — the models, the platform they run on, and the people who build them. This is a role for someone who wants a system with real consequences: fraud decisions that move retailer margin, identity resolution that agents make automated decisions on, and an adversary on the other side who adapts every quarter. For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT OR PST hours. We are fully remote. Day-to-day Own the ML charter across identity resolution, fraud and abuse detection, risk scoring, and consumer intelligence — strategy, roadmap, and delivery Build and grow a high-performing, globally distributed team of ML engineers; hire, coach, and develop senior ICs and managers Set the technical bar for how models get built, evaluated, deployed, and monitored — and hold the org to it Push identity resolution coverage, precision, and profile classification accuracy against a measured, frozen-holdout baseline — not against vibes Own IRIS model performance end-to-end: detection rate, false-positive rate, label quality, and the feedback loops that keep both honest as fraud patterns shift Build the ML platform layer — feature stores, training pipelines, model registry, online serving, drift and performance monitoring — so model velocity isn’t bottlenecked on infrastructure Partner with the AI engineering team so identity and risk signals are first-class inputs to NAVI’s agent decisions Work directly with Product, Engineering, Security, and Customer Success to translate messy retailer problems into ML problems worth solving — and to say no to the ones that aren’t Own build-vs-buy and data-partner decisions (third-party identity data, enrichment providers), including the economics Communicate model performance, risk, and tradeoffs credibly to executives, retailers, and the board What We’re Looking For We care more about judgment and ownership than credentials. You’re likely a strong fit if you: Have 12+ years in engineering with 5+ years managing ML or data teams, including managing managers or senior ICs Are an engineer at heart — you can still read a training pipeline, review a feature spec, and tell when an eval is measuring the wrong thing Have shipped ML systems that make consequential automated decisions in production, and have owned them after launch — drift, retraining, incidents, and all Have deep experience with at least one of: entity resolution / identity graphs , fraud and abuse detection , risk scoring , or anomaly detection at scale Understand what makes ML different from software: labels are noisy and delayed, systems fail silently, offline metrics lie, and last quarter’s model is fighting last quarter’s adversary Have opinions about evaluation — precision/recall tradeoffs on heavily imbalanced data, holdout hygiene, feedback loops where the model’s own decisions contaminate future labels Have built or scaled ML infrastructure: feature pipelines, training orchestration, online model serving with real latency budgets, monitoring and alerting Are fluent in Python and comfortable in a modern data stack (Spark, Airflow or equivalent, streaming, cloud data warehouses — we run on GCP) Have hired well, retained well, and can point to engineers whose careers got better on your watch Excel in a fast-paced environment with a flat structure — you set direction by earning trust, not by mandate Have a BS/MS in computer science, statistics, or an equivalent background Bonus points These aren’t hard requirements, but strong indicators: You’ve worked on identity resolution or graph systems against third-party consumer data (credit bureau, telecom, or similar), including the matching logic and confidence scoring underneath You’ve operated adversarial ML systems where attackers actively adapt to your detection You’ve built real-time inference paths where identity or risk has to be resolved inside a request budget You’ve worked in retail, payments, fintech, insurance, or marketplace trust & safety You’ve partnered closely with LLM/agent teams and understand how structured ML signals ground agentic decisions You’ve navigated privacy, consent, and data-governance constraints on consumer identity data You’ve done 0→1 — stood up a function, a platform, or a data partnership from nothing You use modern tooling (including AI-assisted development workflows) to increase leverage, not outsource thinking Why ML at Narvar? Because the data is genuinely rare and the problems are genuinely hard. The dataset is a moat. Cross-retailer visibility across 20B+ orders means we can see coordinated fraud patterns no single retailer can — a returns abuser hitting five brands looks like a good customer at each one. The problem is adversarial and unsolved. Returns fraud and policy abuse are growing faster than retail itself, and the counterparty adapts. There is no off-the-shelf answer. The stakes are measurable. Fraud loss, false-positive cost, identity coverage, resolution rate. Not vanity metrics. It feeds something bigger. As AI shopping agents enter commerce, every agent will need a trust layer for returns, claims, and delivery promises. Identity and risk are that layer — and you’d own it. The work is greenfield enough to matter. Real-time resolution, cold-start modeling, historical backfill, new data partnerships — these are decisions still being made, not legacy you inherit. Why Narvar (from an engineer’s perspective)? Real scale, real customers, real consequences Startup-level ownership with platform-level impact Teams that value thinking, judgment, and responsibility Low ego, high trust, and room to do your best work We’re on a mission to simplify the everyday lives of consumers. Post-purchase is a critical phase of the customer journey. That’s why we created Narvar - a platform focused on driving customer loyalty through seamless post-purchase experiences that allow retailers to retain, engage, and delight customers. If you’ve ever bought something online, there’s a good chance you’ve used our platform! From the hottest new direct-to-consumer companies to retail’s most renowned brands, Narvar works with GameStop, Neiman Marcus, Sonos, Nike, and 1300+ other brands. With hubs in San Francisco, Atlanta, London, and Bangalore, we’ve served over 125 million consumers worldwide across 10+ billion interactions, 38 countries, and 55 languages. Pioneering the post-purchase movement means navigating into the unknown. Our team thrives on this sense of adventure while nurturing a mindset of innovation. We’re a home for big hearts and we leave our egos at the door. We work hard but we always make time to celebrate professional wins, baby showers, birthday parties, and everything in between. We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. #LI-Remote Below is the estimated annual salary for this position and does not include the other components that make up a Narvar offer including: annual bonus, equity, and benefits. The range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across Canada. Within the range, individual compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to, skill set, education and certifications, and work location. Narvar Salary Range $240,000—$270,000 CAD Please read our Privacy Policy to learn what personal information we collect in connection with your job application, and how we may use and share it.

content.description: Description \*\* This is an opportunity to join our top-notch product delivery team working closely together on interesting projects for our clients. You will work closely with clients, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to define priorities, manage backlogs, and deliver modern data solutions that drive measurable business value. This 100% remote role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, experience working on cloud-based data platforms, and a solid understanding of data warehousing, reporting, governance, and agile delivery practices. Highlights & Benefits of working at Emergent Software Work closely with other talented software engineers and analysts . Our vetting process means you can count on your team members to know what they are talking about. Work from home or work remotely from anywhere you want Flexible work schedule meaning you can work regular hours or whenever you work best Work-life balance is essential and highly valued at Emergent Software. If you choose to work more than 40 hours, you’ll be compensated for the extra work! Work on interesting projects solving complex business problems with custom software. 100 hours per year to focus on your professional development . We invest in your growth! Profit sharing bonus means as we’re successful, you’re successful Excellent benefits package including medical insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, FSA, disability, life insurance, and paid parental leave Primary Duties Partner with clients to establish product vision and backlog Partner with clients to assist them in performing the Product Owner role In depth requirements gathering and analysis. Document requirements as Features and User Stories to share with team. Work with your team and client to create a plan for delivering on project objectives and achieving business value. Partner with technology teams to establish client technology roadmap Collaborate heavily with technology experts (architects and engineers) to vet requirements for technical feasibility. Speak with intelligence on technology topics to clients to establish trust and confidence. Partner with delivery teams to execute on established plans Communicate technical and business requirements to delivery team. Collaborate with senior delivery team members to solve complex challenges. Demonstrate strong understanding of custom software development concepts and best practices in all interactions. Ensure projects stay on target by regularly communicating status, risks, and change as they occur. Be a champion of the agile software development process Work directly with clients to manage project delivery while encouraging and fostering an agile delivery method. Apply agile concepts in real world settings, adapting principles to client’s level of agile sophistication and working to improve maturity over time. Own backlog health and communicate deviation to expected value delivery proactively. Act as a servant leader to your delivery team. Required Qualifications Product Ownership experience 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst on complex data engineering projects. Experience in delivering data engineering projects on modern cloud data platforms and familiarity with concepts around data warehousing, medallion architecture, Power BI, master data management, data governance, etc. Experience in crafting cost estimates to deliver components or entire projects. Strong technical writing, verbal communication, and presentation skills are a must. Experience operating as the liaison between agile development teams and users in defining requirements, performing business analysis, and driving delivery in the right direction. Technology knowledge Experience utilizing AI tools in product development, product delivery, or project management. A solid understanding of how websites, web applications, APIs, databases, and the cloud function at a high level. Strong technical background enabling you to provide credible leadership to development teams and accurately evaluate complex project risks and issues. Experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach Solid understanding of software development life cycle models including expert knowledge of Agile principles. Experience with agile work organization tools (Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello, Basecamp, Rally). A proven track record of successfully implementing custom web application projects using Agile methodologies. Experience with Traditional Project Management concepts Experience with scope, schedule, budget, and risk management Must be viewed as a trusted source of truth by stakeholders through consistent, transparent, and confident communication. Owns the narrative around project delivery, ensuring stakeholders are informed, aligned, and reassured throughout the lifecycle. Occasional travel to client sites may be requested for activities such as annual planning meetings. Although travel is not expected to be frequent, the ability to accommodate occasional travel is required. Nice to Have Experience Strong preference towards candidates with experience delivering projects to client expectations, especially in a consulting capacity, software as a service environment, or delivering AI-accelerated (agentic) solutions. Industry recognized Agile process certification (PMI-ACP, Scrum Alliance CSM or CSPO, Scrum.org PAL, SAFe, or equivalent) Industry recognized Project management certification (PMP or equivalent) Microsoft Azure technology certifications (AZ-900, DP-900, AI-900) Experience on projects utilizing Microsoft stack technologies such as .NET, SQL Server, and Azure as well as JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, and Vue.js Some examples of profiles/backgrounds that we feel would do well in this role: Scrum master turned product owner Independent consultant with previous experience on agile delivery teams (any role) Someone who is a product owner with a passion for the technical side of software development Our Vetting Process At Emergent Software, we work hard to find the best analysts capable of delivering high quality software for our clients. If you think you’re one of those, please understand that the effort put into this by people like yourself helps us be successful in surrounding you with other top-notch people. Here are the steps of our vetting process for this position: Application (5 minutes) Online Assessment (40-50 minutes) Initial Phone Interview & Technology Knowledge Assessment (45 minutes) Challenge Interview (75 minutes) Final Interview (90 minutes) Job Offer! Benefits Package Details Medical Insurance: up to 90% of your monthly medical premium (HSA options available) HSA Contribution: up to $200month Dental & Vision Insurance: up to 50% of your monthly dental and vision premium costs 401(k) plan: company match up to 4% of salary Profit sharing bonus: up to 15% of salary paid quarterly Extra compensation: get paid extra for work over 40 hours/week Employee referral & customer referral bonuses Flex Spending Account (FSA) for Dependent Care & Healthcare Costs Dependent Care FSA Contribution: $90/month Short Term Disability: $500/week for 12 weeks Long Term Disability: up to $6,000/month Group term life and AD&D insurance: $50k PTO, standard holidays, 2 floating holidays Paid parental leave: 2 weeks Staff development program: 100 hours/year plus training costs About Emergent Software Emergent Software is a fast-growing software development, cloud consulting, and data engineering company serving clients across the country. We are a remote-first company Since our inception, we’ve embraced a remote-friendly culture, promoting work flexibility beyond the norm. When the pandemic struck in 2020, our transition to fully remote work was seamless—just a matter of cleaning out the fridge. content.title: Solutions Engineer at Sona (getsona.com)
content.description: Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they’re among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labor shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organizations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That’s a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We’ve raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here. About the Role We’re hiring a US-based Solutions Consultant to join the commercial team and support Sona’s expansion into the American market. Reporting to the Director of Solution Consulting in London, you’ll be a go-to technical and solution-led partner for our growing US sales team, working primarily across the Hospitality and Retail sectors. This is a founding role. The US playbook is still being written, and you’ll be one of the people writing it. That means shaping how Sona sells in the US, creating demo flows and assets tailored to the market, and partnering closely with Account Executives to turn complex workforce challenges into confident buying decisions. You’ll also work alongside Product and Implementation to feed insights back from the US market and ensure seamless customer handovers. To do that well, you’ll need deep familiarity with the workforce management or HR tech space, the ability to lead discovery and demos that are consultative rather than feature-led, and the self-sufficiency to operate effectively with half your day running ahead of the UK team. The SC function at Sona has real influence on how we win enterprise deals and on what we build next. Responsibilities Own the technical and solution-led side of the US sales process, from discovery through to proof-of-concept engagements and RFP responses. Partner with Account Executives to tailor and lead product demonstrations that connect Sona’s capabilities to customer pain points and business outcomes. Build deep expertise in the Sona platform and become a trusted advisor to US prospects and customers across Hospitality and Retail. Develop and refine US-specific technical sales assets, including demo environments, competitive positioning, and sector-specific playbooks. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Implementation to relay US market feedback and ensure seamless handovers post-sale. Contribute to building Sona’s US go-to-market capability - shaping processes, sharing insights, and raising the bar for how we sell. Requirements Experience as a Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, or in a technical pre-sales role - we’re also open to implementation backgrounds with strong commercial exposure. A background in scheduling, workforce management, HR tech, payroll, or adjacent products. For this founding role, knowing the space matters - you’ll need to be credible in WFM conversations from day one. You’ve worked in a startup or scaleup environment with a complex, modern product that changes frequently. You learn fast and thrive on ambiguity. Strong discovery and storytelling skills - you lead with problems and outcomes, not features, and you can adapt your narrative to different personas and sectors. You’re self-starting and proactive, and capable of building process where none exists, seeking out what you need, and operating independently across timezones. Bonus: experience with AI-powered products, or a genuine interest in applied AI. Bonus: you’ve been in an early-stage solutions role and know what it takes to build the function, not just run it. Benefits Salary: $170,000 - $200,000 + 25% target bonus Hybrid: NYC, minimum 2 days a week. Travel to London and to customers across North America expected Share options 20 days PTO + sick days 401k contributions, employer match up to 2% Comprehensive health cover via Aetna Enhanced parental leave & pay Annual all expenses paid team retreats The latest MacBook and equipment budget for your home office Professional development budget Unlimited free books Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a US-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

content.title: Founding Sales Development Representative at Sprinto
content.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto’s extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don’t wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren’t built by sitting together, they’re built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Sprinto is scaling its enterprise motion in the US, and this role is the tip of the spear. As an Enterprise SDR , you will own the first conversation with senior stakeholders at target enterprise accounts across North America. You will build and execute an outbound engine built on real cold calling volume, sharp account planning, and the ability to create urgency where none currently exists. You will partner closely with your Account Executive to build multi threaded relationships across buying committees and convert target accounts into qualified pipeline. This is not a role for someone who wants to lean on inbound leads or events traffic. This is full cycle , self sourced outbound, built from scratch. Where you’ll leave your mark? Own the phone. Consistently drive high volume outbound calling against a defined target account list. You are comfortable picking up the phone and are not intimidated by rejection. Multithread enterprise accounts. Go wide and deep within each account, engaging multiple personas with tailored messaging across call, email, and LinkedIn. Create urgency, don’t wait for it. Most enterprise buyers do not walk in with an immediate need. You know how to surface a real business problem, tie it to a KPI they care about, and build a case for why now. Convert target accounts into Sales Accepted Leads. Work a named account list, qualify conversations rigorously, and hand off only real opportunities, not just booked meetings. Partner with your AE. Work hand in glove with your Account Executive to prioritize accounts, plan territory coverage, and drive quota attainment together. Get better every week. Track your own connect rates, meeting rates, and conversion from conversation to opportunity. Refine your approach constantly. The kind of builder we’re looking for - You have real experience in outbound sales , whether as an SDR, BDR, or in a directly comparable high volume, high rejection selling environment. You can point to specific numbers: dials per day, connect rates, meetings booked, and you can walk someone through your last closed opportunity from first touch to conversion. You have sold, or sold into, complex organizations with multiple stakeholders , and understand what multithreading actually means in practice. You are genuinely good on the phone. You think on your feet and build trust through curiosity, not a call script. You know how to create urgency in a conversation where the buyer did not walk in looking for a solution. You are commercially curious . You research accounts, understand what makes a buyer tick, and adjust your approach account by account, not template by template. You thrive on coaching and feedback, and you are looking to build the foundation for a long term sales career. Experience selling into security, compliance, or technical B2B SaaS personas is a strong plus, though not required if your outbound fundamentals are excellent. How we care for our Sprinters We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit $1,000 annually to help you level up your skills, your domain knowledge, and anything else that makes you sharper. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited PTO so you can reset when you need to, without counting days. Your safety net, woven in: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, plus life insurance coverage. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in to help you build a home setup that works for you, so the environment never gets in the way of the work. $80,000 - $95,000 a year Inclusion & Diversity At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve and the impact they create, not their background or personal circumstances. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

content.title: Principal Software Engineer at HubSpot
content.description: About the Team HubSpot’s Adaptive Monetization group owns the systems that determine how customers buy, contract, and pay for HubSpot — at scale, with direct financial consequence. Our infrastructure handles usage metering, contract orchestration, and subscription lifecycle management for every customer on the platform. An outage here doesn’t just affect user experience; it blocks customers from purchasing HubSpot entirely, and bugs typically produce immediate, measurable financial impact. We’re in the middle of a multi-year shift to transform HubSpot’s straight-line SaaS subscription model and replace it with a flexible contracting layer that can support usage-based billing, commit-based pricing, and enterprise-grade contract structures. This work has executive visibility and is directly tied to HubSpot’s revenue growth and ships meaningful impact to our customers. The core team for this role is roughly 15 engineers across 3 focused team, with an additional influence and impact radius that extends across approximately 180 engineers in the broader Fintech organization. About the Role We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help architect, build, and influence the evolution of HubSpot’s monetization model and strategy — and to do it incrementally, on a system that is live and load-bearing every day. This is a hands-on technical role. Approximately 70-80% of your time will be spent writing code, leading designs, reviewing architectures, and owning technical direction on some of the most complex systems at HubSpot. The remainder will be split between cross-functional strategy, mentoring, and building technical credibility across the broader fintech engineering organization. This is not a greenfield opportunity. The ideal person is someone who finds genuine satisfaction in making a complex, mission-critical legacy system incrementally better — and who can bring others along on that journey. If you’ve thrived at a publicly traded fintech company navigating the intersection of audit rigor, product velocity, and distributed systems complexity, this role was written for you. What You’ll Do Architect the future of HubSpot’s contract and monetization layer Lead the technical strategy for moving HubSpot from a fixed SaaS subscription model to a flexible contracting platform that supports usage-based, commit-based, and enterprise-grade pricing structures. Define and own the core architecture for contract lifecycle management, usage metering, entitlement enforcement, and pricing model extensibility — using our internal Corex contract orchestration framework as the foundation. Make principled tradeoffs between correctness, compliance, and product velocity in a system where the stakes are financial. Be a deeply hands-on, high-leverage builder Write production code regularly. Lead design reviews. Own large initiatives end-to-end, from architecture through rollout. Drive multi-team technical efforts that span the three squads within Adaptive Monetization and require coordination across the broader fintech organization. Turn ambiguity into clear technical direction and working software — and stay hands-on throughout. Navigate complexity without creating it Incrementally improve systems that cannot be rewritten from scratch. HubSpot’s current contract infrastructure is load-bearing; this work requires surgical precision, not clean-slate thinking. Bring the team with you — identifying paths forward that are safe to ship incrementally while maintaining reliability. Raise the bar on resilience and observability in a system that generates dozens of production pages per day as the business shifts toward new pricing models. Communicate with clarity across the organization Translate deeply technical architectural decisions for finance, compliance, legal, and executive stakeholders. This role requires you to operate effectively in rooms where the other people are not engineers. Influence the product roadmap by helping leadership understand technical tradeoffs between speed, correctness, and long-term platform health. Represent the engineering perspective on pricing strategy, contract flexibility, and go-to-market changes that require systems changes to support. Grow the fintech engineering organization Mentor senior and staff engineers within Adaptive Monetization and across the broader Fintech org. Partner with your peers — including the other Fintech principal engineers — to align on patterns that reduce complexity and increase reliability across the organization. Participate in recruiting and help raise the hiring bar for technical talent in the fintech space. What You Bring Proven experience designing and evolving distributed systems with strict financial correctness requirements — billing infrastructure, payment processing, contract management, usage metering, or similar. A background at a publicly traded company where audit rigor, compliance constraints, and real-money consequences shaped the way you built software. Engineers from Stripe, Block, Adyen, PayPal, or similar environments tend to arrive with the right instincts for this work. The ability to operate effectively on complex, legacy systems that cannot be paused or rewritten — you know how to make progress incrementally while protecting reliability. Strong executive communication skills. You can walk a CFO or compliance officer through a technical architecture decision, adapt the framing to what they care about, and leave the room with alignment. A mentorship orientation. You’re someone junior engineers seek out, and you measure your impact in part by how much better the engineers around you get. Comfort with ambiguity. The system this role is responsible for is changing faster than it was designed to handle. You’ll receive a lot of signal and need to make good decisions quickly. Deep backend engineering expertise. This is not a platform, DevEx, or infrastructure role — the work is in the financial logic, data models, and service contracts that power HubSpot’s monetization. Why This Role Matters HubSpot’s ability to offer commit-based enterprise contracts, charge based on usage, and compete for the largest, most complex customers in the market depends entirely on the contracting and monetization infrastructure this role will help build. This is multi-year work with direct revenue consequence and executive visibility — and the person who leads the technical architecture of this system will have a meaningful impact on what HubSpot can sell, and to whom, for years to come. content.title: Engineering Team Leader - UK at StarCompliance
content.description: Role Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Engineering Team Lead is accountable for the leadership, technical direction, and end-to-end delivery of an engineering team responsible for key components of the StarCompliance Enterprise SaaS platform. This role combines strong technical leadership with people management and delivery accountability. Success is achieved through the capability and output of the team, while maintaining sufficient technical depth to guide design, challenge decisions, and support complex engineering work. You will own the full lifecycle of the software and services within your team’s domain, from design and development through deployment, operation, modernisation, and continuous improvement. StarCompliance is moving towards an AI-first, agentic software development model. You will lead this transition within your team, establishing ways of working where engineers and AI agents collaborate effectively across the software development lifecycle. How We Think About AI AI is a foundational part of modern software engineering at StarCompliance. We expect Engineering Team Leads to: Embed AI-assisted and agentic development into everyday engineering workflows. Enable appropriate engineering tasks to be safely delegated to AI agents. Ensure AI-generated changes are tested, validated, secure, and auditable. Use AI to improve delivery speed, quality, automation, and engineering capacity. Continuously adopt new AI capabilities where they provide measurable value. AI-generated output remains engineering output, and teams remain accountable for everything they deliver. Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & People Development Own the technical direction of systems and services within the team’s domain. Lead design decisions and ensure alignment with StarCompliance architecture and engineering standards. Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge designs and resolve complex problems. Drive modernisation, simplification, and reduction of technical debt. Ensure scalability, security, resilience, performance, and maintainability are built in. Technical Leadership Own the technical direction of systems and services within the team’s domain. Lead design decisions and ensure alignment with StarCompliance architecture standards. Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge designs and support complex problems. Drive modernisation, simplification, and reduction of technical debt. Ensure scalability, security, resilience, performance, and maintainability are built in. AI-First & Agentic Engineering Lead adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices. Structure work so engineers and agents can deliver effectively together. Increase the proportion of development activity that can be safely automated. Establish automated validation and guardrails for AI-generated changes. Measure AI adoption through improvements in throughput, quality, and engineering capacity. Delivery, Quality & Operations Own end-to-end delivery and ongoing health of the team’s products and services. Translate product priorities into clear and achievable engineering outcomes. Balance feature delivery with quality, resilience, security, and technical sustainability. Ensure software is tested, deployable, observable, supportable, and production-ready. Drive automation across testing, CI/CD, deployment, and operational processes. Use engineering and production data to improve quality and delivery effectiveness. Quality, CI/CD & Operational Excellence Ensure engineers own the quality of the software they create. Embed appropriate automated testing and quality controls throughout the SDLC. Drive high levels of CI/CD automation and low-risk, repeatable deployments. Ensure services provide effective telemetry, logging, monitoring, and alerting. Use production data and incidents to drive continuous engineering improvement. Platform & Collaboration Build solutions using modern Azure, cloud-native, and reusable platform capabilities. Partner with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Security, and Product. Work across team boundaries to resolve dependencies and systemic engineering issues. Communicate delivery, technical risks, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders. Contribute to engineering-wide standards, forums, and improvement initiatives. Skills and Experience Significant software engineering experience, including technical and people leadership. Strong experience with C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core. Strong understanding of APIs, software architecture, and modern integration patterns. Strong experience with microservices, containers, and distributed systems. Experience with infrastructure as code and automated environment provisioning. Experience with event-driven architecture and asynchronous messaging. Experience building and operating enterprise SaaS or cloud-hosted applications. Experience with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript. Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly SQL Server. Practical experience with Microsoft Azure, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern engineering practices. Understanding of observability, resilience, performance, and secure software development. Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools and agentic development approaches. Experience supporting or leading AI-first or agentic engineering transformation. Proven ability to lead engineers, manage delivery, allocate resources, and influence across teams. Strong technical judgement, communication, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills. Minimum Qualifications Minimum Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Experience within regulated SaaS or financial-services technology. content.title: Industrial AI Cloud - Infrastructure Engineer (REF5794M) at Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions HU
content.description: Company Description As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries. DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team. Job Description General description/ Purpose NVIDIA and Deutsche Telekom are jointly developing the world’s first industrial AI cloud for European manufacturers. This AI factory in Germany will host 10,000 GPUs across NVIDIA DGX B200 systems and RTX Pro Servers. Deutsche Telekom provides secure, sovereign and fast infrastructure, including data centers, operations, security, and AI solutions. Role Overview We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to build, automate, and operate compute, network, and storage environment of the Industrial AI Cloud. In this role you will provision and maintain servers, manage networking (on server OS level) and storage, automate deployments, implement monitoring, and ensure reliable day-to-day operations of large-scale GPU clusters. You’ll be working and coordinating between multiple teams to deliver and continuously improve infrastructure services following ITIL processes. Key Responsibilities Coordinate Operations with Data Center Teams: Coordinate and support hardware lifecycle activities (installs, GPU upgrades, storage expansion, firmware updates) and manage server/network interconnections and related documentation (NetBox). Server & Node Management: Provision and maintain bare-metal servers and GPU nodes (PXE boot, OS installs, firmware updates). Design & Operate NVIDIA AI related infrastructure stack Automation & IaC: Develop and maintain Ansible and Terraform playbooks to automate provisioning, configuration, and deployments. OS & Firmware Management: Maintain Debian-based environments, apply patches, and manage firmware upgrades at scale. Identity & Access Management: Integrate and maintain Keycloak, Entra ID / CAIMAN, and AD for user authentication and authorization. Run AI & HPC Workloads: Support and operate distributed AI workloads within bare metal hosts and Kubernetes environments. Monitoring & Observability: Operate Prometheus and Grafana stacks for proactive infrastructure monitoring and alerting. Storage Administration: Manage high-performance storage environments (WEKA by Hitachi). ITIL Processes: Follow and improve incident, problem, and change management workflows; document runbooks and standard operating procedures. Adhere to ZERO Outage guidelines. Consult and provide project deliverables to fulfil the project scope with focus on Nvidia technology stack. What We Offer Work on Europe’s first industrial AI cloud with cutting-edge technologies. Direct collaboration with NVIDIA and Deutsche Telekom experts. Hybrid working model, training opportunities, and career progression. Qualifications Required Skills and Qualifications Experience in hardware installation, maintenance, and operations. Advanced proficiency with Linux (Debian preferred) in production environments. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Ansible, Terraform); Redfish desirable. NVIDIA GPU-Accelerated server platform knowledge Knowledge of Nvidia AI software stack related to GPU orchestration GPU based Cloud platform software stack knowledge incl. its dependencies on below layers Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (IP, routing, VLANs, DNS, firewalls and L1, L2). Experience with identity and access management systems (Keycloak, Entra ID, LDAP). Familiarity with monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana). Knowledge of high-performance storage systems (WEKA by Hitachi advantageous) advantage. Working knowledge of ITIL processes (incident, problem, change). Strong troubleshooting and operational support skills in a 24/7/mission-critical environment. Preferred Attributes Experience with large GPU clusters, HPC, or data center environments. Knowledge of sovereign cloud and data security/compliance requirements. Familiarity with Terraform, GitOps for infrastructure changes. Additional Information You will be working in the European Union to meet our customers’ data security and privacy requirements. \* Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

content.title: Account Director, Social Media at BrandBastion
content.description: BrandBastion transforms the way brands handle social engagement, working with some of the most recognized names in the world – Netflix, Uber, Sephora, Benefit Cosmetics, JD Sports and more. We help our partners get the most out of their social media engagement, across paid, organic, and non owned conversations. Our proprietary technology automates the management of millions of social interactions every day, while maintaining the personal quality of one-on-one conversations grounded in context, brand knowledge and TOV. About the Role: BrandBastion is looking for a strategic, commercially minded Account Director with deep experience in organic social media, community engagement and enterprise client leadership. This is not a paid media or campaign execution role. We need someone who understands what happens after content goes live, how brands manage communities, engage audiences, protect their reputation, deliver customer care and use social conversations to inform broader business decisions. And on top of that, understand that tooling and AI will make it possible. You will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be accountable for the overall customer relationship, account strategy, value realization, retention and growth. You must be comfortable acting as the primary senior partner to leaders such as Global Heads of Social, VPs of Marketing and Customer Experience executives. Our product, technical and operational teams will support platform configuration, onboarding and workflow optimization. However, you will need to understand the platform, confidently advise customers on how to use it and take hands-on ownership of moving accounts forward. What you’ll own Take direct ownership of a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, including customer outcomes, senior relationships, retention, renewals and expansion Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across social media, marketing, brand, community and customer care Develop a clear account strategy based on each customer’s priorities, organizational structure and measures of success Lead strategic conversations across organic social, community management, moderation, engagement, social customer care, sentiment and brand health Connect BrandBastion’s platform and services to measurable customer outcomes and business value Lead executive business reviews that provide insights, recommendations and clear next steps Identify adoption gaps and account risks early, then personally drive the plan to address them Own commercial conversations related to renewals, expansion and additional BrandBastion solutions Partner with product and technical specialists to improve workflows, platform adoption and customer results Bring customers relevant social trends, industry knowledge, examples and strategic ideas Maintain strong organization and follow-through across multiple complex accounts and stakeholder groups Experience as an Account Manager, Account Director, Client Partner, Social Strategist, Social Media Lead or senior customer leader Experience working with large consumer brands through an agency, social technology company or in-house team The credibility to lead a useful strategic conversation with a Global Head of Social or VP of Marketing Strong knowledge of social strategy, community, engagement, moderation, customer care and campaign performance A commercial mindset and experience with retention, renewals, growth or account expansion Strong ownership, organization and follow-through The ability to translate data and customer goals into clear recommendations Comfort learning technology and partnering with technical specialists A proactive, hands-on approach to managing and growing accounts At BrandBastion, high performers shape their own path. You’ll have opportunities to: Lead strategic initiatives that impact our Social AI-first approach. Advance into senior leadership roles based on performance. Work with global brands at the forefront of digital engagement. Be part of a fast-growing AI-first company leading the future of Social Engagement Competitive Market Rate Compensation + 4+ weeks paid time off Opportunities for global team meets Flexible, Fully Remote Role: Enjoy the benefits of remote work while collaborating with a talented global team.
